Set up a secure screen lock in Android settings first. If biometrics are unavailable, use your phone PIN.

Disable the lock for Zeitkonto on this device?
Require a strong biometric or your phone PIN whenever you return to Zeitkonto. This protects access on this device; your email login remains necessary.
Print the current view or save it as a PDF? For the yearly calendar, first select the annual view in the app.
No browser is available on this device.

Android test version 0.1.2. Uses the existing Zeitkonto website and Supabase account. Native background reminders and purchases are not included yet. Offline reopening and printing need testing on your device. Login and email recovery links can also be used in the browser. Local data stays in Android private app storage; this version does not add separate Keystore encryption to the web database. Uninstalling deletes local changes that have not synchronized.
Open time recording, calendar or balance in Zeitkonto.
